value.reason:
Statement. The question is whether every finite bipartite graph with an edge and no 4-cycle (girth at least six, forests included) satisfies t(H,W) >= t(K_2,W)^{e(H)} for every graphon W. The resolution criteria and the Lean finite-host Statement (artifact e671e600) are exact and agree with the prose. I checked the Lean statement line by line:

- edgeSet.Nonempty requires an edge.
- 'No IsCycle walk of length 4' means no 4-cycle.
- homCount counts all maps, including noninjective ones.
- edgeDensity is 2e/m^2.
